name: Founders
description: Founders start the Grain suit Production Chain. Founders are double-sided. Each player starts with a Founders in their Village, the 2-Gold side face up. It will turn to the Food side if a player has no Food at the end of the Build Phase. Each player has a different illustration for their Founders. There are no functional differences between them.

name: Lumberjack
description: Lumberjacks are Basic Villagers that start the Wood suit Production Chains. Basic Villagers are double-sided with different illustrations (male and female). You can choose which side is shown for all Basic Villagers in Preferences.

name: Hayer
description: Hayers are Basic Villagers that start the Hay suit Production Chains. Basic Villagers are double-sided with different illustrations (male and female). You can choose which side is shown for all Basic Villagers in Preferences.

name: Miner
description: Miners are Basic Villagers that start the Ore suit Production Chains. Basic Villagers are double-sided with different illustrations (male and female). You can choose which side is shown for all Basic Villagers in Preferences.

name: Apprentice
description: Replace any non-Top villager in any village with the Apprentice, then place the replaced villager in your Village.
clarification: Clarification: The Apprentice can swap places with any villager in any Village that is covered by another card in its Production Chain. He can be used in other player's Villages, or in your own. The card he swaps places with must then be placed in your Village immediately, following the normal rules for placing Villagers. Using the Apprentice only uses up one build action, not two. Though the Apprentice cannot be used to steal another player's Founders (as stated in the rules for Special Villagers), he can be used on your own Founders, if they have at least one card placed on top of them. If you do you can choose which side of them you place face-up.

name: Monk
description: The Monk can be used as any one villager in a Production Chain. The Monk can't be the top (last) villager of a Production Chain. Clarification: The Monk can be used as any villager, as long as you don't make him the top card of a Production Chain. This means he will always be placed at the same time as another villager, with the Monk below the other, taking the role as one of the villagers in the Production Chain. The Production Chain he is used in must have all the other cards in correct order. 2 Monks can be used in the same Production Chain. Monks and Apprentices : These do not act as the cards they are replacing, they are simply villagers with no symbols printed on them, except their Suit Symbol, they belong to the Special suit. Their purpose is to be placed below other villagers. The next villager in the Production Chain must always be on top of the Monk or Apprentice. If for any reason, a Monk or an Apprentice becomes the top card of a Production Chain, it returns back to the hand of the player whose village it was in. If an Apprentice or Monk is the bottom card of a Production Chain, it can have 2 cards on top. They must be of the same suit.

name: Smuggler
description: Earn half the printed Gold value of a villager in your Village, rounding up. Discarded after use Unlocked by: Shipwright

name: Tinner
description: Unlock any Padlocks on any villagers played together with the Tinner for free. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: The Tinner can unlock several cards even if they have different unlockers. It does not matter if you or some other player has the Unlocking Villagers, they can be unlocked for free by the Tinner as long as they’re played in the same Build Phase. Players are allowed to mix and match, unlocking some villagers with the Tinner and some without her (to place coins on your own villagers for example).

name: Benefactor
description: Play during the Draft Phase Play a villager from your hand into your village. It cannot be a Special villager. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: You cannot trade in a card from your hand to get a Basic Villager when using the Benefactor, that action must be taken in the Build Phase.

name: Nun
silver_formula: At the end of the game, awards an amount of Gold equal to the Silver value of a villager that you have exactly one of in your Village .
description: At the end of the game, awards an amount of Gold equal to the Silver value of a villager that you have exactly one of in your Village . On Yucata.de , the largest value is automatically chosen.

name: Pigeoneer
description: Look at the top 6 cards of the Reserve and take 1 of them to your hand. Then return the rest in any order. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: After taking the chosen villager to your hand, return the other villagers to the top of the Reserve in any order.

name: Prophet
description: Play during the Draft Phase Look through a stack on the Road and draft a villager from it. Return the rest of the stack in any order. Discarded after use Clarification: The Prophet counts as your Draft for the turn. The Prophet cannot look through the Reserve, the Pigeoneer does that. Return the stack to its place on the Road after drafting, placing the cards in any order in the stack.

name: Recruiter
description: In every Draft Phase turn , you may pay 1 Gold to draft 2 villagers. Your Food Limit still applies.
clarification: Clarification: When using the Recruiter, replace the face-up card you drafted on the Road before picking your next card.
deviation: On Yucata.de this card is not available in Solo Mode.

name: Barbarian
description: Play during the Draft Phase Discard all villagers on the Road , taking the coins into your Supply . Replace the villagers with villagers from the Reserve . Discarded after use

name: Courier
description: Play before another player's turn in the Draft Phase . Take a villager from the road directly to your hand . Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: You must use the Courier before the currently playing player has picked up a card from the Road. Replace the card on the Road with a new one from the leftmost stack as when drafting.
deviation: This card is not implemented on Yucata.de ; players will never receive it.

name: Flaker
description: Play during the Draft Phase Take a villager from any player's Village Square directly to your hand. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: You can also use the Flaker on your own Village Square (this allows you to draft an extra villager as it frees up one Draft Action!)

name: Noble
description: Look through another player's hand and steal one villager from that hand. It cannot be a special villager. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: When using the Noble, you do get to look at both sides of the other player's cards.
deviation: On Yucata.de this card is not available in Solo Mode.

name: Schemer
description: Steal a Top Villager from any Village . Any coins on it go to the owner's Supply. It cannot be a Special villager. Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: Coins on a villager stolen by the Schemer go to the Supply of the player stolen from. You can also use the Schemer to take one of your own villagers back to your hand. If it's a villager with coins on it, the coins go to your Supply.

name: Sheriff
description: Discard a Thief belonging to any player. Take its coins to your Supply . Discarded after use
clarification: Clarification: You can also use a Sheriff on your own Thief to get the coins to your own Supply .

name: Thief
description: In every Build Phase , take 3 Gold from another player's Supply and place them on the Thief.
clarification: Clarification: Coins on the Thief can be scored by other villagers such as the Agent and the Arkwright . The coins on the Thief are scored in the Market Phases just like other coins on villagers. You cannot steal coins from a player with less than 3 Gold in their Supply. You can only steal from another player's Supply, not from Gold placed on their villagers.

name: Alchemist
description: Bronze scoring: Half the value of one of your Silver villagers , rounding down. Played on: Miner On Yucata.de , the largest value is automatically chosen.

name: Arkwright
description: Bronze scoring: 2 Gold for each Villager with any coins placed on it . Played on: Lumberjack

name: Captain
description: Bronze scoring: 1 Gold for each Gold Symbol .
clarification: The Captain scores 1 Gold for each printed Gold Symbol in your Village (he does not score for all your Gold or your coins!).

name: Carter
description: Bronze scoring: 1 Gold for each Production Chain with 3 or more Villagers . Played on: Hayer
clarification: The Carter scores 1 Gold for each Production Chain you have with at least 3 cards. For example a Miner with two Blacksmiths on top will score 1 Gold with the Carter. Similarly, a Lumberjack with a Wheeler and Cartwright on top will also score 1 Gold.

name: Freelancer
description: Any player may place 1 Gold on a Freelancer at the start of their Build Phase to get an extra Build Action .
clarification: You can also pay your own Freelancer to get an extra Build Action. Each player can only pay each Freelancer once in each Build Phase. If both Freelancers are present, a player may choose to pay both, to get 2 extra Build Actions. The maximum of 5 Build Actions still applies.

name: Wholesaler
silver_formula: 3 Gold for each set of 1 Ore, 1 Hay and 1 Wood Symbol
description: Silver scoring: 3 Gold for each set of 1 Ore, 1 Hay and 1 Wood Symbol .

name: Church
description: Condition: the most Villagers Reward: 3 Gold, and one face-down card taken from any stack or the Reserve into your hand
clarification: Clarification: The winner is the player with the most villagers in their Village . So you count the number of villagers, not the Suit Symbols. You may take the top face-down villager from any stack including the Reserve to your hand. You do not need to reveal what you got.
deviation: On Yucata.de this card is not available in Solo Mode.

name: Inn
description: Condition: the most Special Villagers in hand Reward: 5 Gold
clarification: Clarification: When checking who won this, show the other players the backs of the villagers in your hand to show how many Special villagers you have. It is not necessary to show the fronts.
deviation: On Yucata.de this card is not available in Solo Mode.

name: Tavern
description: Condition: the most Solitary Symbols Reward: 3 Gold, and take a Basic Villager into your Village
clarification: You can take any one Basic Villager, either a Miner, Lumberjack or Hayer. Place the chosen Basic Villager in your Village immediately.

name: Sawmill

name: Windmill
description: Condition: the most Production Chains Reward: 2 Gold, 1 Food
clarification: A Production Chain must have at least 2 cards to count as one. So the Solitary villagers for example are not included when checking who won the Windmill.
deviation: On Yucata.de this card is not available in Solo Mode.

name: Countess
description: The Countess village begins with this card instead of a Founders . 4 Gold (except in Beginner Mode)

name: Jester
description: Once per game, The Jester allows you to discard one Event Card of your choice.

name: Betrayer
description: Event: Take a top villager from your village and move it to the Countess village . It cannot be a Basic villager.

name: Black Market
silver_formula: Event: You and the Countess score the Silver villagers in your villages.
description: Event: You and the Countess score the Silver villagers in your villages.

name: Bribes
description: Event: The Countess adds Gold from the Bank to a villager with a keyring in her village . Add as much Gold as the number in the keyring.

name: Customs
description: Event: Pay the Countess 1 Gold for each villager of the suit you have the most of.

name: Guild Conspiracy
description: Event: The Countess adds 2 Gold from the Bank to each villager with a keyring in her village .

name: Land Claim
description: Event: Pay the Countess 2 Gold for each Basic villager in your village .

name: Mood Swing
description: Event: Discard this Event, then deal a new Event from the same deck to replace it. Resolve the new Event immediately.

name: Serfdom
description: In the Build Phase: Getting a Basic villager requires you to place a villager in the Countess village instead of returning it to the Road.

name: Sinister Banquet
description: Event: The Countess earns 2 Gold for each Food in her village .

name: Temporary Employment
description: Event: The Countess earns 2 Gold for each different suit present in your hand .

name: The Countess Bank
description: In the Build Phase: Unlocking by paying the Bank costs 3 Gold.

name: Value Added Tax
description: Event: Pay the Countess 1 Gold for each Gold symbol in your village .

name: Abduction
description: Event: Discard a villager from your hand.

name: Arrest

name: Arson
description: In the Build Phase: 1 less Build action or pay 3 Gold to the Bank.

name: Blackmail
description: Event: The Countess scores the highest printed Gold value on a villager in your village .

name: Conscription
description: Event: The Countess takes an extra villager from a face-down stack on the Road or the Reserve.

name: Dark Mood
description: Immediately when revealed: Discard this event and deal two new events to replace it.

name: -It Was You!
description: The Jester must be played before the end of this round.

name: Protection Money
description: Event: Pay the Countess Gold equal to the value of the coins placed on one of your villagers.

name: Rats
description: In the Draft Phase: Draft 1 less card or pay 3 Gold to the Bank.

name: Spy Network
silver_formula: Event: The Countess earns the value of one of your Silver symbols.
description: Event: The Countess earns the value of one of your Silver symbols.

name: Trade Network
silver_formula: Event: The Countess scores the value of a Silver symbol in her village .
description: Event: The Countess scores the value of a Silver symbol in her village .

name: Tribute
description: Event: Pay the Countess 1 Gold for each villager in your hand .
